scoring_notes: An entry in must_contain may be a string (that substring must appear, case-insensitively) or a list (any one member must appear). groundedness_doc_ids are the doc_ids or source files a correct answer must cite.

questions.question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
questions.reference_answer: A minimum of 75% attendance in the course is required. Between 65% and 75% the shortfall may be condoned by the Dean, Academic Affairs on the Course Instructor's recommendation; below 65% is not condonable and the student is debarred and awarded an F grade.

questions.question: How many Open Elective credits do I need to earn in order to get a B.Tech. degree?
questions.reference_answer: 12 Open Elective credits, normally four 3-credit courses, from courses outside the student's own parent department and at 300 level or above.

questions.question: What is the total number of credits required for a B.Tech. degree?
questions.reference_answer: A minimum of 160 credits, with a CGPA of at least 5.00 and no outstanding F grade.

questions.question: My attendance in a course is 60 percent. Can it be condoned so that I can write the Major exam?
questions.reference_answer: No. Only a shortfall between 65% and 75% is condonable; attendance below 65% is not condonable under any circumstance, and the student is debarred from the Major examination and awarded an F grade.

questions.question: I missed my Minor exam because I was ill. By when do I have to apply for a makeup exam and what do I need to submit?
questions.reference_answer: Inform the Course Instructor within three working days of the missed examination and file Form AC-07 on AIS with a medical certificate from the Institute Medical Centre, obtaining the instructor's recommendation. The application goes to the Makeup Examination Committee. Attendance of at least 75% in the course is a precondition.

questions.question: What is the minimum passing grade in a credit course?
questions.reference_answer: DD is the minimum passing grade in a credit course. For Ph.D. coursework the minimum is higher, BC.

questions.question: What happens if an Incomplete grade is not converted in time?
questions.reference_answer: An I grade that is not converted within the Makeup examination window automatically becomes an F grade.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of credits a B.Tech. student can register for in one semester?
questions.reference_answer: 27 credits, with a minimum of 15. A student with CGPA below 6.00 is capped at 20 credits, and a student on academic probation at 18.

questions.question: What is the last date to withdraw from a course this semester and what grade appears on the transcript?
questions.reference_answer: 30 October 2026 for Semester I of 2026-27. A withdrawn course is recorded with a W grade, which is excluded from SGPA and CGPA. Core courses cannot be withdrawn.

questions.question: How many credits can I transfer from SWAYAM or NPTEL courses, and what do they count towards?
questions.reference_answer: A maximum of 6 credits, counted only against the Open Elective requirement, with prior approval on Form AC-16. Only courses of 12 weeks or more with a proctored examination are eligible, and at least 60% is required.

questions.question: I have a family wedding on the day of my Major exam. Can I get a makeup exam for that?
questions.reference_answer: No. Travel, personal engagements and family functions are explicitly not admissible grounds for a Makeup examination; only medical grounds, bereavement, Institute duty and an unresolvable examination clash are admissible.
